Riziki Industrial Chemicals

How to run the shop on this system

Everything the counter and the owner need, screen by screen — signing in, selling, mixing, stock, debts and closing the day. Each step is shown with the real screen beside it.

Show

The daily rhythm

Morning
Sign in with your own PIN. Glance at the home screen for anything flagged.
During the day
Sell. Record deliveries as they arrive. Mix and repack as needed.
As it happens
Record expenses and any payment a debtor brings in.
Evening
Count the drawer and do Day close. Sign out.
Weekly
Owner: take a backup from Reports and keep it off the phone.
Monthly
Owner: walk the shelf with Stock take and settle the differences.
◈ Start here Everyone

What this system does

Three questions, answered at all times: what is on the shelf, what have we made, and what have we sold.

The shop buys raw chemicals in drums and bags. Some are broken down into smaller packs. Some are mixed into finished products like Jik, Laundry Soap or Toilet Cleaner. Both are sold at the counter, for cash, M-Pesa, or on credit.

The system follows that same path. Every screen you will use is one step on it — nothing more complicated than that.

The one rule worth knowing

Nothing is ever quietly deleted. A wrong sale is voided, wrong stock is corrected with a stock take. The system keeps both the mistake and the correction, so the books always explain themselves.

◑ Start here Everyone

Owner and attendant

Two kinds of account. The attendant sells; the owner sees the money.

Everyone has their own PIN, so every sale is recorded against the person who made it. Never share one account.

AttendantOwner
Sell, take payments, print receiptsYesYes
See stock counts, mix a batch, repackYesYes
See customers and debts, take paymentsYesYes
See cost prices and profitNoYes
See the formulas (what goes into a mix)NoYes
Reports, activity log, add or remove staffNoYes
Why the split is strict

The recipes are the business. An attendant can mix a product perfectly from the Batch screen without ever seeing the quantities that went into it.

→ Start here Everyone

Signing in and out

Pick your name, type your PIN. That is the whole login.

  1. Open the shop link in the phone's browser.
  2. Under Who are you?, choose your name from the list.
  3. Type your 4-digit PIN.
  4. Tap Sign in.
Change the starting PINs on day one

The system ships with demo PINs (owner 1234, attendant 1111). A red banner stays on the home screen until every one of them has been changed. See Change my PIN and Users & settings.

To sign out: tap Sign out at the top right of any screen. Do this at the end of a shift, so the next sale is recorded against the right person.

≡ Start here Everyone

Finding your way around

The five things you need most are always one tap away. Everything else lives under More.

On a phone, five buttons sit along the bottom: Sell, Stock, Batch, Debts, Reports (Reports is owner-only). Everything else is under More.

On a computer or tablet, the same screens sit in a menu down the left side, always visible.

▤ Every day Everyone

Sell — making a sale

The screen the counter lives on. Add what the customer is buying, take the money, hand over a receipt.

The Sell screen has two boards. Products is what the shop makes and bottles. Chemicals is everything sold as a raw material. Tap the board name to switch, or swipe.

Finding an item fast

  1. Type any part of the name in Search — "jik", "sles", "soda ash". Common other names work too.
  2. To add several at once, put the number first: type 3 jik and one tap adds three.

Building the sale

  1. Tap an item to add one. Tap again to add another.
  2. To change a quantity, use − and + in the sale list, or type the number straight into the box.
  3. For a wholesale buyer, tap Wholesale — every price on screen changes at once.

Taking the money

  1. Tap Pay KES …
  2. Check Paying now. It starts at the full bill; change it only if the customer is paying part now.
  3. Choose Cash or M-Pesa. For M-Pesa, type the confirmation code.
  4. If the sale is for a named customer, or anything is left unpaid, pick the customer.
  5. Tap the green button to finish.
Selling on credit

Leave Paying now below the bill and the rest goes on the customer's account. A customer with no credit limit set cannot be sold to on credit unless the owner types their PIN. That is deliberate — see Debts.

After the sale

◎ Every day Everyone

Mix kit and repeat orders

Two shortcuts that save the most typing at a busy counter.

Mix kit — selling the chemicals for a product

A customer who wants to make 20 litres of Carwash Shampoo themselves needs every chemical in the right amount. Mix kit works that out and adds all of them to the sale at once.

  1. Tap Mix kit… above the boards.
  2. Choose the product and how many litres.
  3. Tap Work it out.
  4. Tap the button to add all the ingredients to the sale.
Attendants can use this too

It adds the chemicals and their prices without ever showing the recipe quantities. The formula stays owner-only.

Same as last time

Pick a regular customer at the top of the Sell screen and, if they have bought before, a Same as last time button appears. One tap refills their usual order, which you can then adjust.

▭ Every day Everyone

Receipts and invoices

Print on paper, or send the customer a PDF on WhatsApp.

  1. From a finished sale tap Receipt / invoice. From an older sale, open Sales history and tap it there.
  2. Print sends it to a paired thermal printer.
  3. Share on WhatsApp makes a real PDF and opens the phone's share sheet — tap WhatsApp there and the file goes with the message.
About that extra tap

The share sheet is the only way any website can hand a real file to WhatsApp — a phone security rule, not a fault in this system. The upside is the customer gets a proper PDF invoice instead of a typed-out summary.

◫ Every day Everyone

Sales history

Every sale, newest first. This is also where a mistake gets fixed.

Tap any sale to see its lines, reprint it, or void it.

Voiding, not deleting

Voiding puts the stock back and cancels the money, but the original sale stays on the record marked as voided, with the reason. Both halves stay visible — that is what makes the books trustworthy.

◱ Every day Everyone

Debts — who owes what

Every customer account, oldest debt first, with statements you can send.

Recording a payment

  1. Open Debts and tap the customer.
  2. Tap Record a payment.
  3. Type the amount and choose cash or M-Pesa.
  4. Save. The balance updates straight away.

Sending a statement

  1. On the customer's page tap Print statement.
  2. Use PDF to send it on WhatsApp, or Print for paper.
Credit limits are the owner's decision

Set a limit for each regular and the counter can sell to them on credit without calling the owner. Leave it unset and every credit sale needs the owner's PIN. Set limits for the names that buy on account; leave everyone else unset.

◐ Every day Everyone

Day close

Count the cash drawer at the end of the day and see whether it matches.

  1. Open More → Day close.
  2. Count the cash in the drawer.
  3. Type the counted amount.
  4. If it does not match, write why in the note.
  5. Tap to close the day.
M-Pesa is counted separately

Only physical cash goes in the counted box. The system already knows the M-Pesa total from the sales.

◲ Every day Everyone

Expenses

Money that leaves the shop — rent, transport, tea, casual labour.

  1. Open More → Expenses.
  2. Choose a category, type the amount, choose cash or M-Pesa.
  3. Add a short note so it makes sense next month.
  4. Save.
Why bother

Expenses are what turn takings into real profit on the Reports screen. Skip them and the profit figure is fiction.

▦ Stock & making Everyone

Stock — what is on the shelf

Every chemical and product, with what is left and what needs reordering.

A red Reorder badge means that item has dropped to its reorder level. Stock value at the top is what is on the shelves at cost — owner only.

Stock changes by itself

You never type stock counts here. Selling, mixing, repacking and recording a delivery all move stock automatically. The one place you set a number by hand is Stock take.

◨ Stock & making Everyone

Stock take — correcting the count

Walk the shelf, type what is really there, and let the system fix the difference.

  1. Open More → Stock take.
  2. Search for an item and type how many you actually counted.
  3. Repeat for everything you have counted. Leave the rest blank — blank means "not counted", not zero.
  4. Write the reason in the note box. This is required.
  5. Save. The system posts the difference.
This is the anti-theft control

The reason note is compulsory on purpose. An unexplained correction is exactly what this screen exists to catch, and the owner can see every one of them in the Activity log.

◧ Stock & making Everyone

Repack — breaking a drum down

Turn one 20 kg drum into smaller packs to sell, and record the spillage honestly.

  1. Open More → Repack.
  2. Choose what you are breaking down and how many drums or bags.
  3. Type how many of each smaller pack you filled.
  4. Check the Loss figure, then save.
It will refuse the impossible

If the packs you entered add up to more than the drum held, it will not save — it tells you instead. That is a typo being caught, not the system being difficult.

⚗ Stock & making Everyone

Batch — mixing a product

The heart of the system. Scale a recipe, check the shelf can cover it, mix, and record what came out.

Everything the shop makes is made here. The system scales the recipe to the quantity you want, takes the chemicals off the shelf, works out what the batch cost, and gives it a batch number for the label.

  1. Open Batch.
  2. Choose the product and type how many litres you want.
  3. Tap Work it out.
  4. Check Ready to mix. If a chemical is short it says so and the button stays off.
  5. Weigh out the ingredients listed and mix.
  6. Tap Run batch — this takes the chemicals off the shelf.
  7. When the mix is finished, type the litres you actually got and, if it has been bottled, what into. Then Record yield.
Always record the real yield

Aiming for 20 L and getting 19.5 is normal. Recording the true figure is what keeps the cost per litre honest and the stock count right. Guessing here makes every price built on it wrong.

The batch number matters

It prints on every label. If a customer ever returns a bottle, that number tells you exactly which mix it came from and what went into it — which is what KEBS traceability requires.

◉ Stock & making Owner only

Formulas — the recipes

Owner only. What goes into each product, and the record of every change.

  1. Open More → Formulas.
  2. Tap a product to see or change its recipe.
  3. Change quantities, add or remove a chemical, or edit the mixing steps.
  4. Save. This creates a new version.
Old batches never change

Editing a recipe never rewrites history. Batches already mixed stay attached to the version they were made with, so what they cost stays true. New batches use the new version.

Some recipes need confirming

Recipes marked Check this came off handwritten sheets with something unreadable or missing. Open them and settle the number with whoever knows the mix.

◍ Stock & making Owner only

Products & prices

Owner only. Add items, set retail, wholesale and the lowest price allowed.

Retail is the walk-in price. Wholesale is the trade price. Floor is the lowest anyone is allowed to sell at — the counter cannot go below it without the owner.

  1. Open More → Products & prices.
  2. Change a price and save, or add a new item with its pack sizes.
  3. Set a reorder level so the Stock screen warns you in time.
◰ Stock & making Everyone

Suppliers & purchases

Record a delivery so the new stock — and what it cost — goes onto the shelf.

  1. Open More → Suppliers & purchases.
  2. Add the supplier first if they are new.
  3. Start a purchase, put in the delivery note number.
  4. Add each item, how many, and what was paid.
  5. Add transport if there was any, then save.
This is where cost prices come from

Every delivery updates the average cost of that item, which is what profit is calculated against. Skipping deliveries makes the profit figures drift.

◭ Owner's view Owner only

Reports

Owner only. Takings, profit, what is selling, and what is walking out unexplained.

Profit here is takings minus what the goods cost minus expenses. That is why recording expenses and deliveries matters.

This screen also carries Download full backup. Tap it weekly and keep the file off the phone — on Drive, or email it to yourself.

◊ Owner's view Owner only

Activity log

Owner only. Everything worth arguing about, newest first, and none of it editable.

Nobody can edit or delete this, including the owner. If a figure is ever disputed, this is the record that settles it.

◇ Setup Owner only

Users & settings

Owner only. Staff accounts, and the shop details that print on every invoice.

Adding someone

  1. Open More → Users & settings.
  2. Type their name, give them a PIN, choose Attendant or Owner.
  3. Save. They can sign in immediately.

When someone leaves

Switch them off rather than deleting them. Their past sales must stay attached to their name.

Shop details

Business name, phone, KRA PIN and the cash float. These print on every invoice and receipt, so get them right once.

▬ Setup Everyone

Receipt printer

Pair a Bluetooth thermal printer with the counter phone.

  1. Turn the printer on.
  2. On the counter phone open More → Receipt printer.
  3. Tap to connect and choose the printer from the phone's list.
  4. Send a test print.
  5. Set the paper width to match your roll (58 mm or 80 mm).
Chrome on Android only

Bluetooth printing needs Chrome on Android. iPhones and Firefox cannot talk to Bluetooth printers at all — that is the browser's limit, not this system's. The screen tells you if you are on the wrong one. Everything else works everywhere; you can still make a PDF and share it.

◘ Setup Everyone

Change my PIN

Anyone can change their own PIN, any time.

  1. Open More → Change my PIN.
  2. Type your current PIN, then the new one twice.
  3. Save.
Do this before the shop goes live

The PINs the system ships with are public — they are printed on the sign-in screen. Until every one is changed, a red banner stays on the home screen.

◌ Setup Everyone

When the internet drops

Keep selling. The system saves the sales and sends them when the line comes back.

The counter does not stop when the network does. The screen shows Offline and a count of sales still waiting to send.

  1. Keep selling exactly as normal.
  2. Each sale says Saved on this phone instead of a sale number.
  3. You can still print or make a PDF — it is marked PENDING until it reaches the till.
  4. When the network returns the sales send themselves. Nothing to do.
Two things to know

Stock counts shown while offline are from the last time there was a connection, so they can be a little behind. And the real invoice number is only issued when the sale reaches the till — reprint from Sales history afterwards if the customer needs the numbered copy.

Install it on the phone

In Chrome, open the menu and choose Add to Home screen. It then opens like an app and offline works properly. Test it once: turn on flight mode and check the Sell screen still loads.
